faq.a1: The technician comes, looks at the problem, and quotes a price before starting — work only begins once you approve it. If you don't approve, only the fixed visit fee may apply.
faq.a2: Every technician's identity and background are checked before they earn the 'Verified' badge and start appearing in search. Nobody can be booked without that verification.
faq.a3: Once the job is done, you can pay online (card/UPI) or in cash — either way. The price itself is agreed before work starts.
faq.q4: What if I'm not happy with the work?
faq.a4: You can raise a complaint on the booking and our team looks into it. You can also leave a review, which helps other customers decide.

howItWorksPage.metaDescription: From booking to payment — every step of how {{app}} works, explained.
howItWorksPage.heroTitle: From booking to payment — the full process
howItWorksPage.heroSubtitle: Every booking guarantees three things: a verified technician, an upfront price, and an OTP-secured visit.
howItWorksPage.trustBody: Every technician goes through an identity, background and skill check before they ever join the platform. Only once that's complete do they earn the 'Verified' badge and start showing up in search — nobody gets booked without it. As they complete more jobs and earn good ratings, technicians climb to Silver and Gold badges, so the most experienced, reliable ones are easy to spot.

faq.q1: What if the technician doesn't show up on time?
faq.a1: You can cancel the booking or get in touch with us. A technician showing up late or not at all affects their rating.
faq.a2: Payments run through Razorpay, one of India's major payment gateways. We never store your card details ourselves.
faq.a3: When the technician reaches your home, you share a start code with them — it confirms it's really the technician you booked. A second code confirms the job is finished.

privacy.metaDescription: How {{app}} collects, uses and protects your information.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.draftNotice: This policy is a first draft and is pending legal review. Anything shown in [ ] has not been finalised yet.
privacy.intro: {{app}} ('we', 'us') is a marketplace that connects customers with verified technicians. This policy explains what information we collect, why, for how long, and what rights you have under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act).
privacy.dataCollectedBody:
Phone number (for identity and sign-in) · name · address and location (from GPS or entered by you) · booking and payment history · device ID · for technicians: ID documents, skills and experience details · basic usage data (like which pages you view) · messages and complaint records between you and our team or a technician.
We never store your full card or payment details on our own servers — that stays with the payment gateway (Razorpay).
privacy.purposeBody:
To create bookings and match you with a technician · to verify a technician's identity and background · to process payments and issue receipts · for sign-in and security checks · to prevent fraud and investigate complaints · to send booking updates over WhatsApp/SMS (our primary notification channel) · where required by law.
We never sell your data, and we don't use it for advertising.
privacy.sharingBody: Information needed to complete a booking (like your name, address, and a masked version of your phone number) is shared with the assigned technician — only as much as the job needs. Payment details are shared with the payment gateway (Razorpay). Whatever's needed to deliver a notification is shared with our WhatsApp/SMS provider. Our support and operations team can see information to investigate a complaint or a safety issue. We may also share information with government authorities where the law requires it. Beyond that, we do not give your information to any third party.
privacy.retentionBody: Basic profile information is kept for as long as your account stays active. Booking, payment and complaint records are kept for longer (typically several years) to meet legal and accounting requirements. After you ask us to close your account, anything we're not legally required to keep is deleted or anonymised.
privacy.securityBody: We use OTP-based sign-in instead of passwords, so there's no password to be stolen. Data in transit is encrypted (HTTPS). Only team members who genuinely need it can access your information, and every access is logged in an audit trail. Even so, no system on the internet can be guaranteed 100% secure.
privacy.rightsHeading: Your rights under the DPDP Act
privacy.rightsBody: The right to access your information and ask what we hold · the right to correct inaccurate information · the right to withdraw consent (after which some services may stop working) · the right to request erasure of your information, where the law allows it · the right to file a grievance · the right to nominate someone to exercise these rights on your behalf. To use any of these rights, contact the grievance officer below.
privacy.grievanceBody:
Name: [Grievance officer's name — coming soon]
Email: [Email — coming soon]
Phone: [Phone number — coming soon]
Address: [Registered address — coming soon]
Any data-related grievance will be answered within the timeline the law requires.
privacy.childrenBody: This service is not meant for anyone under 18. We do not knowingly collect information from children. If we discover we've collected a minor's information by mistake, we will delete it promptly.
privacy.changesBody: This policy may be updated from time to time. Significant changes will be announced on the website or over WhatsApp/SMS. The version shown here is always the current one.

terms.metaDescription: The terms and conditions for using {{app}}.
terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.draftNotice: This is a first draft and is pending legal review. Anything shown in [ ] has not been finalised yet.
terms.intro: By using {{app}}, you agree to the terms below. Please read them carefully.
terms.eligibilityBody: You must be at least 18 years old and have a valid Indian mobile number to use this service. Information you give us must be accurate and kept up to date.
terms.accountBody: Sign-in works through a code sent to your phone number — there is no password. You're responsible for keeping your phone and that code secure. Never share your code with anyone, except as part of the confirmed process for starting or ending a job.
terms.bookingBody: {{app}} is a marketplace that connects customers with independent technicians — technicians are not our employees. A technician quotes a price after seeing the job, and work only begins once you approve it. Any change in price (for example, if a new problem turns up mid-job) requires your approval again.
terms.paymentsBody: You can pay online (card/UPI via Razorpay) or in cash. Online payments get an instant receipt. Cash payments are recorded by the technician — if the amount looks wrong, raise a complaint right away.
terms.cancellationBody: Depending on the booking's status, you can cancel by choosing from the listed reasons. Cancelling repeatedly without reason may affect your ability to book in future.
terms.conductBody: We expect customers and technicians to treat each other with respect. Any threat, fraud or unsafe behaviour is taken up immediately, and an account may be suspended where necessary.
terms.liabilityBody: We verify technicians, but we cannot guarantee the quality of every job 100%. If something goes wrong, use our complaint process — our team reviews the case and takes appropriate action, which can include a refund or action against the technician.
terms.disputesBody: Any dispute will first be worked through our complaint process. These terms are governed by Indian law, and the courts of [city — to be finalised] will have jurisdiction.
terms.terminationBody: You can ask to close your account at any time. We may also suspend or close an account for violating these terms.
terms.changesBody: These terms may be updated from time to time. Continuing to use the service means you accept the updated terms.
terms.contactBody: For any question about these terms, see our contact details on the /contact page.
